name: The Presence Protocol
subtitle: For the father who's in the room and isn't there.
toc_note: Read it with a pen. Part I takes an honest hour. Part V takes three minutes, in the middle of dinner, with nobody noticing.
back_line: They don't need your perfection. They need your aliveness.
back_sub: If you're home every night and still missing, you don't have a character problem. You have a logistics problem. This is the system for staying alive in your own house.
